status_note: Papers identified via web search; primary full texts not retrievable this session.
direction: Offline consolidation and governed ontology/memory evolution
summary: Offline consolidation ("dreaming") and governed, feedback-driven ontology/memory evolution are the dominant 2026 themes. Three findings are relevant to World0; all rest on search summaries, so evidence strength is capped at EXPERIMENTAL/SUPPORTED.

findings.title: Pre-failure offline memory repair (MemDream)
findings.discovery: Offline Dreamer/Analyst/Consolidator agents probe and repair a memory graph before retrieval fails; reversible soft decay.
findings.relevance: Template for a World0 Dream Mechanism operating on concepts and relations rather than facts.

findings.title: Ontology as a dynamically refined agent kernel (OaK)
findings.discovery: Task-oriented ontologies/KGs are built and refined from judge feedback.
findings.relevance: Validates feedback-driven ontology evolution; contrast with World0's single structure plus context projection.
findings.action: Full-text read; extract judge-feedback loop design.

findings.title: Consolidation needs write governance (SSGM)
findings.discovery: Evolving memory risks logical drift; validation at consolidation is proposed as a guard.
findings.relevance: Supports concept-integrity-first priority for LLM-written cards/relations.

deep_note: Verification: metadata and summary taken from web-search result summaries only; the arXiv page could not be fetched in this session (network egress to arxiv.org unavailable). Quantitative details are reported only where the search summary stated them.

insights.label: EXPERIMENTAL
insights.note: MemDream and Auto-Dreamer indicate a growing offline-consolidation line.

insights.label: SPECULATIVE

insights.label: SUPPORTED
insights.note: Multiple independent papers converge on governed, feedback-driven consolidation.

recommendations: Prototype a non-RL dream cycle reusing existing projection-eval scripts (E-001).
Add a validation gate for LLM-written cards/relations (E-002).
Keep structure as shared concept-world with context-conditioned projection; do not adopt per-task ontologies wholesale.
